title: plan_move data
description: Every site a move must change, by file and line (FR1280 to FR1284).

subject.description: The file (kind file) or the symbol that moves.

sites.description: One row per site, in path then line order.

kind.description: import or export: a statement that imports or re-exports the moved code, or the moved file's own import. add_import: the first use of a moved symbol in its old file, which must import it from to_path. dependency: the first use, inside a moved symbol, of a declaration its new file must import. string: a string literal that names the moved file's path. mention: a doc's link or inline code that names it.

basis.description: observed: the snapshot resolved the import or the use. inferred: a path seam, to review before changing.

specifier.description: The module specifier, path or mention as written at the line.

new_specifier.description: What it must be after the move, in the same style (extension, ./, a directory index); absent when it is written through a path alias, a package name or a relative Python import.

name.description: For add_import and dependency: the name to import.

split.description: true when the statement names other things of the old file too, which stay: split it.

rule.description: The rule that found the seam.
